answer: Bond the grader, not just the answer. Every agent that grades or attests posts a grading bond, and each verdict is later checked against the sealed consensus it helped form. A grader whose verdicts systematically diverge, rubber-stamping its farm or voting at random, forfeits a slice of bond per bad verdict, down to a nadir where it can no longer grade. An operator seating aliases as jurors to pass its own fakes must bond each and watches each bond burn as collusion shows up as deviation. Honest graders on the ledge of consensus keep bond and seat; a forge of fake jurors melts under audit.
